title: Multi-discipline: search across API, UI, tests and docs

steps.request: Add search to the notes app. Backend: `GET /api/notes?q=<text>` returns only the notes whose title or body contains the text, case-insensitively (no q = all notes, as today). Frontend: a search box above the list, with a proper label, that filters the list as you type by calling that endpoint. Add backend tests for search, and a short 'Search' section to the README.

acceptance: GET /api/notes?q= filters title/body case-insensitively; no q returns all; POST still works
UI: labelled search input that calls /api/notes?q=
New backend tests mention search; npm test passes
